$comment: Known axe-core violations on the audited public routes (Issue #393). One record per route and rule. A violation that is NOT listed here fails the release candidate; a record that no longer matches an observed violation fails too, so the ledger cannot be emptied to turn the gate green. See docs/verification/a11y/axe-route-report.md.
